sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission assessed the WA Police capacity to manage misconduct during 2008 and 2009.
sentences.support: the Commission undertook an analysis of the capacity of the WAPOL misconduct management system to prevent, identify and deal with misconduct.

sentences.text: It investigated three previously mishandled cases, reviewed allegations at different risk levels and visited police districts and organisational units.
sentences.support: investigating three cases that had previously been the subject of inadequate WAPOL internal investigations

sentences.text: The Commission found that police dealt adequately with more than 96 per cent of allegations, but identified weaknesses in some high-risk investigations and the classification of lower-risk matters.
sentences.support: This analysis revealed that more than 96% of misconduct allegations are adequately dealt with by WAPOL.

sentences.text: It concluded that some investigation failures reflected insufficient rigour and willingness to address difficult issues.
sentences.support: Inadequacies in WAPOL investigations in relation to these cases appeared to stem from an apparent lack of will by WAPOL

sentences.text: Its seven recommendations covered apologies, conflicts of interest, computer access, investigation quality, complaint resolution training and clearer complaint procedures.
sentences.support: The Commission makes the following recommendations to address the inadequacies identified in this report.

notes: Existing OPAX findings are not duplicated. Allegation categories and inadequacies in police investigations are kept distinct from findings about individual alleged incidents.
